svg.text: LEYLINES, TECHNOTICLAN: the lake city, THE PLAN over the room as it stands (a proposal)
north is up · one plot = 12 x 12 squares = 42 m · room site_prebuilt_gobekli_ow_babel
The trail, the bee yard · was 0 → 0 · level
as built · the Shrine on top
the city as it stands today (read from the room)
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
▒ a STAIR (real stair pieces cut in the face; walked both ways)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.

Plot lines by district: T = Babel (its own plan) · R = the trail (the route kit's) · Z = Technoticlan. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height. A PROPOSAL: nothing is built from it until mondo
